en.title: Spain holds general strike over housing crisis before election
en.dek: The 24-hour stoppage began in Spain over rising housing costs according to The Guardian and CNBC.
facts: Spain held its first general strike in 14 years on 11 November 2026
Renting a one-bedroom apartment in central Madrid costs about three-quarters of the average salary according to Semafor
The stoppage occurred weeks before an election where the far right could gain power according to The Guardian and CNBC
body: Millions joined Spain’s general strike on 11 November 2026 according to The Guardian
The stoppage lasted 24 hours as reported by CNBC
Protestors reportedly clashed with police during the general strikes ahead of the election campaign according to CNBC
Housing costs fueled the general strike in Spain according to Semafor
A one-bedroom apartment in central Madrid costs about three-quarters of the average salary according to Semafor
The general strike took place weeks before an election where the far right could gain power according to The Guardian and CNBC
en.context: The general strike occurred in Spain over the housing crisis according to The Guardian and Semafor. The election mentioned in the sources is weeks away according to The Guardian and CNBC.

body: Millionen nahmen am Generalstreik Spaniens am 11. November 2026 teil, laut The Guardian

en.headline: Spain holds first general strike in 14 years over housing crisis
en.body: The 24-hour stoppage has drawn high participation across sectors and comes weeks before election in which far right could gain power, according to The Guardian and CNBC. Renting a one-bedroom apartment in central Madrid costs about three-quarters of the average salary, according to Semafor.

fr.headline: Espagne : première grève générale en 14 ans contre la crise du logement
fr.body: La grève de 24 heures a mobilisé fortement plusieurs secteurs et intervient quelques semaines avant des élections au cours desquelles l'extrême droite pourrait accéder au pouvoir, selon The Guardian et CNBC. Le loyer d'un appartement d'une chambre en centre Madrid représente environ trois quarts du salaire moyen, selon Semafor.

de.headline: Spanien ruft ersten Generalstreik seit 14 Jahren gegen Wohnungsmarktkrise aus
de.body: Der 24-Stunden-Ausstand verzeichnet hohe Beteiligung in allen Sektoren und findet Wochen vor Wahlen statt, bei denen die Rechte laut Guardian und CNBC starke Gewinne erzielen könnte. Nach Semafor-Angaben kostet die Miete für eine Einzimmerwohnung in zentraler Madrid etwa drei Viertel des durchschnittlichen Gehalts.

es.headline: España vive su primera huelga general en 14 años por la crisis de la vivienda
es.body: El paro de 24 horas ha registrado una alta participación en todos los sectores y se produce semanas antes de unas elecciones en las que la extrema derecha podría acceder al poder, según The Guardian y CNBC. Alquilar un apartamento de un dormitorio en el centro de Madrid cuesta alrededor de tres cuartas partes del salario medio, según Semafor.

pt.headline: Espanha realiza primeira greve geral em 14 anos devido à crise da habitação
pt.body: A paralisação de 24 horas registou uma elevada participação em vários setores e ocorre semanas antes da eleição na qual a extrema-direita pode chegar ao poder, segundo o The Guardian e a CNBC. Arrendar um apartamento de um quarto no centro de Madrid custa cerca de três quartos do salário médio, segundo a Semafor.

it.headline: La Spagna registra il primo sciopero generale in 14 anni sulla crisi abitativa
it.body: Lo sciopero di 24 ore ha registrato un'alta partecipazione in tutti i settori e arriva poche settimane prima delle elezioni in cui l'estrema destra potrebbe conquistare il potere, secondo The Guardian e CNBC. Affittare un appartamento con una camera da letto nel centro di Madrid costa circa tre quarti dello stipendio medio, secondo Semafor.

zh.headline: 西班牙14年来首次因住房危机举行全国大罢工
zh.body: 据《卫报》和CNBC报道，此次24小时停工获得各行业广泛参与，且发生在选举前几周，极右翼可能在此次选举中上台。据Semafor报道，在马德里市中心租一套一居室公寓的费用约为平均工资的四分之三。

ko.headline: 스페인, 주택난에 14년 만에 첫 총파업
ko.body: 가디언과 CNBC에 따르면, 24시간 파업은 여러 부문에서 높은 참여율을 보였고 극우가 정권을 잡을 가능성이 있는 선거를 몇 주 앞두고 벌어졌다. 세마포어에 따르면 마드리드 중심부의 침실 1개 아파트 임대료는 평균 임금의 약 4분의 3에 달한다.

ja.headline: スペイン、住宅危機めぐり14年ぶりのゼネスト
ja.body: 24時間のストライキは幅広い分野で高い参加を集めており、極右が権力を握る可能性がある選挙の数週間前に実施された。ガーディアンとCNBCによると、マドリード中心部の1ベッドルームのアパートを借りる費用は平均給与の約4分の3に相当するという。セマフォーによると。
